mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, company_name, license_no, contact_person, contact_phone, address, status, remark, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM t_supplier WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT id, user_id, company_name, license_no, contact_person, contact_phone, address, status, remark, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM t_supplier WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_supplier (user_id, company_name, license_no, contact_person, contact_phone, address, status, remark, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{companyName}, #{licenseNo}, #{contactPerson}, #{contactPhone}, #{address}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{isDeleted}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_supplier SET company_name = #{companyName}, license_no = #{licenseNo}, contact_person = #{contactPerson}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, address = #{address}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_supplier SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
